name: The Number 9
overview: The number 9 in Scripture is associated with God's covenant and divine communication, as seen in Genesis 9:9 where God establishes His covenant with Noah and his descendants. It also marks significant moments of God's revelation to His people, such as in Numbers 9:1 when the Lord speaks to Moses in the wilderness. These instances underscore God's faithfulness and guidance, culminating in the ultimate revelation of salvation through Jesus Christ, who declares Himself as the way to the Father and the source of eternal life (John 14:6, John 3:16).
